purpose: Map controlled property evidence fixtures to dependent tests, pathways, propositions and validation runs so material fixture changes trigger explicit re-validation without silently altering historical results.

trigger_rules.fixture_rejected: Required active dependencies become BLOCKED; optional dependencies require review.
trigger_rules.fixture_corrected: Material correction requires dependent tests to be re-run; prior results remain immutable.
trigger_rules.provenance_error: Source-derived dependencies require provenance review before reuse.
trigger_rules.privacy_issue: Affected fixture use is blocked until privacy review passes.
trigger_rules.source_updated: Source-derived fixture enters REVIEW_REQUIRED and its provenance/legal period must be reviewed.
trigger_rules.fixture_superseded: Active dependencies require a replacement fixture or explicit historical-only classification.

guardrails: Fixture lifecycle changes never silently rewrite historical validation runs.
A material fixture change requires a new validation run.
Synthetic fixtures remain synthetic and cannot establish real-world legal facts.
Source-derived fixtures retain provenance and require provenance review after material source change.
Fixture approval is not legal-source verification and is not live-record retrieval.
Fixture dependencies support testing only within explicitly mapped propositions and pathways.

impact_outputs.fixture_change: Return affected test cases, validation runs and pathways before reuse.
impact_outputs.required_revalidation: Create a new validation run rather than modifying a previous run.
impact_outputs.historical_preservation: Retain prior run, fixture version and dependency state as historical records.
